relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of these receptors by neuron-derived ATP promotes BDNF release.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: It also alters the neuronal chloride gradient such the normal inhibitory effect of GABA is converted to excitation.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF also promotes the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines from astrocytes.

key_findings: Review: in males, microglial P2X4-driven BDNF release underlies neuropathic pain via altered chloride gradient and cytokine release; in females T-lymphocytes act instead.
